     a. For each iteration, read a line of input, split it into a username and a rating.
     b. Append the tuple (username, integer rating) to the list users.

fix_code:
def main():
    N = int(input())
    users = []
    for i in range(N):
        username, rating = input().split()
        users.append((username, int(rating)))
    users.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    total_rating = sum(user[1] for user in users)
    winner_index = total_rating % N
    print(users[winner_index][0])
